name: Canvas Fly
description: Paintings by a real fruit-fly nervous system. 165,122 traced neurons of the male Drosophila CNS connectome (HHMI Janelia FlyEM, Cambridge Connectomics Group, Google Research, CC-BY 4.0) look at a canvas through the fly's own retina and move a brush with the descending neurons a fly walks with. One token per sitting, 5,000 at most. The synaptic gains evolve between sittings, so the pictures drift. Every token stores the PNG's SHA-256 and the sitting's seed on chain, replayable to the pixel. Watch it paint: https://connectomecanvas.com
